planSteps.description: Find the password input field and enter 'My-Drop-Site' to unlock the site.
Navigate to /auth. Enter admin email 'admin@rimanfashion.com' and password 'riman-admin-2024'. Login successfully.
Navigate to /admin. Verify the admin dashboard loads with stats cards, charts, and sidebar navigation.
Click Products in the admin sidebar. Verify the products list loads with a table of products and an Add Product button.
Click Orders in the admin sidebar. Verify the orders list loads with order statuses and customer info.
Click Appointments in the admin sidebar. Verify the appointments list loads with service types and statuses.
Click Calendar in the admin sidebar. Verify the calendar view loads showing appointments on dates.
Click Settings in the admin sidebar. Verify the settings panel loads with branding, contact, and feature flag sections.
Click Content in the admin sidebar. Verify the content editor loads for homepage and about sections.
Verify all admin navigation links work: Dashboard, Products, Orders, Appointments, Calendar, Content, Settings.
